title: The Lancashire Creamery Farm Shop Vanilla Shortbread 100ml Shortfill
description: The Lancashire Creamery’s Vanilla Shortbread captures the comforting simplicity of classic Shortbread infused with the rich warmth of Vanilla. The buttery biscuit base delivers a mellow sweetness with delicate crumbly notes, while the Vanilla adds a smooth, aromatic depth that lingers on the exhale. This indulgent blend offers a perfectly balanced dessert vape, ideal for those who enjoy soft, buttery bakery flavours. With a 70% VG / 30% PG formulation, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, making it ideal for high-powered vape kits, mods, sub-ohm tanks, and low-resistance coils. The thick VG content ensures dense vapour production while delivering consistently rich flavour. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The Lancashire Creamery is a UK-based e-liquid brand known for crafting rich, indulgent dessert flavours. Their shortfill collection blends classic bakery, custard, and milkshake profiles, delivering smooth, full-bodied vapes for those who enjoy creamy, sweet treats.
